title: Silo Harness settings.json
description: Settings for Silo Harness: ~/.silo-harness/settings.json (yours) and <project>/.silo-harness/settings.json (a project's, applied once you trust it). See https://github.com/BrandeisPatrick/silo-harness/blob/main/docs/configure.md

$schema.description: The schema this file follows (for editors).

env.description: Environment variables set for the app before the rest of the file is read; keys can live here.

workingDirectory.description: Your own settings.json only: the folder the app opens in.

provider.description: The provider in use: "ollama", "portkey", or the name of an entry in "providers".

permissionMode.description: The permission mode a session starts in.

maxTurns.description: How many model calls one request may make before it stops and asks you to continue.

sendScreenshotsToModel.description: Attach browser screenshots to the conversation as images (needs a vision model).

systemPromptExtra.description: Added to every request: house rules, coding style, project context.

autoTitles.description: Name a session from its first exchange.

autoCompact.description: Summarise the conversation on its own when it nears the context window.

compactThreshold.description: How full the context window gets before the conversation is summarised.

pruneToolResults.description: Shorten old tool results for the model: past 48K tokens, and before summarising.

notifications.description: Notify when a run finishes or needs approval while the app is in the background.

keepAwake.description: Keep the Mac awake: never, while a session runs, or whenever the app is open.

toolSet.description: Which tools the model is offered: auto adds the browser, terminal and other groups when a task needs them; all sends every tool with every request; essential is auto without schedules, sub-sessions and mods.

toolActivity.description: Fold each run of tool calls into one line, or show every call.

historyTrashDays.description: Days a deleted session stays in the trash.

checkForUpdates.description: Look for a newer release on GitHub once a day and show a quiet line when there is one.

toolConcurrency.description: How many read-only tool calls of one reply run at the same time; 1 runs every call one after another. Default 4.

timingLog.description: Write each run's timing (numbers only, no content) to timing/timing.jsonl in the app's data folder.

baseURL.description: The Ollama server's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1.

model.description: The Ollama model tag, e.g. qwen3:8b.

numCtx.description: Tokens of context Ollama is asked for (num_ctx).

think.description: Thinking mode for models that can reason.

baseURL.description: The gateway endpoint (Portkey, or any OpenAI-compatible gateway). Not allowed in a project file.

apiKey.description: The gateway key (x-portkey-api-key); falls back to PORTKEY_API_KEY. Not allowed in a project file.

providerApiKey.description: The upstream provider's key, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Not allowed in a project file.

contextWindow.description: The model's context window in tokens.

keepCookies.description: Keep the Browser pane's cookies and site data when the app quits.

downloadsDir.description: Where downloads are saved; empty for the Downloads folder.

openChatLinksInPane.description: Open links from the chat in the Browser pane instead of the default browser.

alwaysAllowed.description: Sites the agent may use without asking (https://example.com, *.example.com, localhost:3000). An entry without a scheme covers https only (and http on localhost).

sensitive.description: Sites that always ask before the agent acts, beside the built-in list.

exempt.description: Hosts the agent may use freely, like localhost; a folder makes the files in it exempt.

environment.description: What Auto mode's safety check should know about this Mac, e.g. "aisolutions-dev is a dev AWS account". Your own settings.json only.

allow.description: Plain-language rules the safety check allows, e.g. "Deploys to staging". Your own settings.json only.

model.description: The safety check's model: "<provider>:<model>" or a model id of the session's provider. Empty: the session's own model. Your own settings.json only.

learn.description: Record your answers on approval cards and give them to the safety check as earlier decisions (default true). Your own settings.json only.

provider.description: The web_search backend. duckduckgo needs no key.

apiKey.description: The key for brave, tavily or exa. Not allowed in a project file.

baseUrl.description: Your SearXNG instance, e.g. http://localhost:8888 (it may be on your own network). Not allowed in a project file.

providers.description: Named providers. "provider" selects one by its name. The names "ollama" and "portkey" are taken by the built-in blocks.

type.description: The kind of service. Each type knows its base URL, its usual key variable and any headers.

label.description: How the window names it (default: the type's name).

baseURL.description: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint; overrides the type's. Required for openai-compatible. In a project's settings.json only for services that take no key (ollama, lmstudio, or openai-compatible without a key).

apiKey.description: The key itself. Only in your own settings.json or config.json, never in a project's file; prefer apiKeyEnv.

apiKeyEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the key (the env block of settings.json counts). Default: the type's, e.g. OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Ignored in a project's settings.json, which may not choose whose key is sent.

model.description: The model to run, as the service names it.

models.description: Models to offer in the model picker.

headers.description: Extra request headers; ${VAR} is expanded in the values (not in a project's settings.json).

contextWindow.description: The model's context window in tokens (default 128000); drives the context meter and auto-compaction.

maxOutput.description: Most tokens one reply may have, sent as max_tokens (default: the service decides).

config.description: portkey: a config id for routing, fallbacks and caching (x-portkey-config).

provider.description: portkey: a provider slug (x-portkey-provider), e.g. openai.

numCtx.description: ollama: the context size asked for (num_ctx).

think.description: ollama: thinking mode for models that can reason.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the session's model calls (the pill next to the model). Unset: the model's default. Clamped to the levels the model takes.

prices.description: Prices for the cost estimate, in dollars per million tokens, by model id. They override the built-in prices of Claude models on Anthropic's API and price any other model.

cacheRead.description: Tokens read from the prompt cache (default: the input price).

cacheWrite.description: Tokens written to the prompt cache (default: the input price).

hooks.description: Commands and HTTP endpoints run before and after the agent acts, in Claude Code's format. A project file's hooks run only once you trust the file. See docs/hooks.md.

matcher.description: Which occurrences fire: a name, names separated by | or ",", or a regular expression; "*" or empty matches all.

type.description: command and http run; mcp_tool, prompt and agent are Claude Code types this app skips (with a problem line).

timeout.description: Seconds before the hook is cancelled (default 600; 30 on UserPromptSubmit).

if.description: Tool events only: one permission rule, e.g. "Bash(git *)" or "Edit(*.ts)". The handler runs only when the tool call matches it.

statusMessage.description: Shown in the status line while the hook runs.

onFailure.description: Whether the action goes ahead when the hook fails, times out or cannot start (default "continue").

command.description: The shell command (sh -c), or with "args" the program to run directly. Reads the event as JSON on stdin.

args.description: Exec form: the arguments, passed as they are with no shell.

async.description: Run in the background; its decision is not waited for.

asyncRewake.description: Read as async in this app.

shell.description: Accepted for Claude Code compatibility; this app runs shell-form commands with sh.

url.description: POSTed the event as JSON; the response body is read like a command hook's stdout.

headers.description: Extra headers; $VAR and ${VAR} are filled in from allowedEnvVars only.

disableAllHooks.description: Turn off every hook from the settings files (mods' hooks still run).
